mapper.select: SELECT id FROM shops WHERE owner_user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'ACTIVE' FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO products (shop_id, sale_status, current_published_revision_id) VALUES (#{shopId}, 'OFF_SALE', NULL)
INSERT INTO product_revisions (product_id, revision_number, title, summary, status, created_by_user_id) VALUES (#{productId}, 1, #{title}, #{summary}, 'DRAFT', #{userId})
mapper.sql: p.id AS productId, pr.id AS revisionId, pr.title, pr.summary, pr.status AS revisionStatus, p.sale_status AS saleStatus, pr.created_at AS createdAt
mapper.select: SELECT FROM products p JOIN shops s ON s.id = p.shop_id JOIN product_revisions pr ON pr.product_id = p.id WHERE s.owner_user_id = #{userId} AND p.id = #{productId} AND pr.id = #{revisionId} AND pr.status = 'DRAFT'

SELECT FROM products p JOIN shops s ON s.id = p.shop_id JOIN product_revisions pr ON pr.product_id = p.id WHERE s.owner_user_id = #{userId} AND pr.status = 'DRAFT' ORDER BY pr.created_at DESC, pr.id DESC LIMIT 50
